items.description: Germany's far-right AfD wants to revive coal and nuclear power and curb non-EU immigration. Businesses in eastern Germany warn that its policies could harm the economy.

items.title: Can inspectors return to Iran's nuclear sites?
items.description: The UN nuclear watchdog says inspections of Iran's nuclear program are possible in principle. The bigger question is whether Tehran will allow meaningful access.

items.title: NASA launches spacecraft to recover sinking telescope
items.description: The Swift telescope has been affected by recent solar storms and is sinking faster than ever, heading toward Earth. A NASA mission will try to capture it and boost its orbit.

items.title: Free electricity in Australia, and the week's other eco wins
items.description: Germans save an ancient woodland from coal mining, Australia gives away surplus solar power, and how one city became the world's best place for cyclists?

items.title: Google, Amazon emissions rise sharply, driven by AI boom
items.description: US tech giants Google and Amazon have reported a strong increase in greenhouse gas emissions in 2025. AI data centers are behind the rise, challenging the companies' climate pledges.

items.title: Heat wave: European countries report 3,700 excess deaths
items.description: Thousands of excess fatalities have been recorded across Europe following last week's heat wave, especially among older people. In France, the prime minister is facing a no-confidence vote over the crisis.

items.title: EU sanctions Russian researchers involved in Navalny's death
items.description: The six sanctioned Russian scientists were linked to the production of epibatidine — the deadly toxin identified in the body of Putin critic Alexei Navalny after his death.

items.title: Sick leave: Germany rising but not the worst in Europe
items.description: Sick leave in Germany has hit a new record, with workers taking an average of nearly 20 days off per year. As Chancellor Merz cracks down, how does the country's absenteeism compare to other countries?
